text.p: 1600 GMT - The Romanian leu closed Wednesday at 3,610/25 to the dollar, weaker than Tuesday's close of 3,600/15, on an interbank market hit by hard currency shortages.
* The leu's reference rate was 3,610 to the dollar.
* Operators said deals on crosses yielded around 4,300 to the dollar.
* At licensed money exchange offices, the leu oscillated around 4,750 to the dollar, close to levels recorded on Tuesday.
* The money market remained overliquid in lei with one-week funds near 40 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
